name: secrets-levels
description: Places a secret at the right level of the Webgrip estate and names the manifest that puts it there: floor (SOPS), vault (OpenBao), cluster (External Secrets), bridge (Forgejo Actions and Cloudflare Worker secrets), short-lived (OIDC, dynamic credentials, per-run tokens), person (a laptop). The placement half of the secrets model; guard-secrets is the enforcement half.
